name: System Control
description: Power, audio and application control for this machine.

actions.name: power.sleep
actions.description: Put this machine to sleep. On Windows this hibernates rather than sleeps whenever hibernation is enabled — say so if asked, rather than claiming it slept.

actions.name: power.shutdown
actions.description: Shut this machine down. Applications with unsaved work are not forced closed, so a shutdown can be cancelled by a dialog on the machine itself.

actions.name: audio.get_volume
actions.description: Read this machine's current output volume, as a percentage.

actions.name: audio.set_volume
actions.description: Set this machine's output volume. Takes a percentage from 0 to 100.

actions.name: audio.mute
actions.description: Mute or unmute this machine's output.

actions.name: process.list
actions.description: List the applications currently running on this machine.

actions.name: process.close
actions.description: Ask an application to close, by its executable name. Nothing is force-closed, so an app with unsaved work can refuse.

name.description: Executable name, e.g. notepad.exe or Spotify.

actions.name: process.launch
actions.description: Open a file or application by its full path on this machine. Takes a path, not an application name.

path.description: Absolute path to the file or application.
